name: The romance in four phases
hint: Two who meet, fall, pull back and fight for love. The ending is happy. Each step can become several chapters.

parts.title: The meeting
chapters: The first
One lead in their life: what they want, what is missing and the lie about love they live by. Give the reader a reason to like them at once.
The second
The other lead, with a goal of their own and a reason not to want to fall in love right now. In dual POV, this is their first chapter.
The meeting
They meet in a way that grates or sparks, and the reader knows at once that these two are the couple.
Not a chance
Both give concrete reasons why this can never become anything. The reasons must hold for half the book.
Bound together
Something outside forces them to keep meeting: a job, an inheritance, a bet, a fake relationship. Without it, they just go home.

parts.title: Falling in love
chapters: A first sign
A look, a laugh or a favour that will not be forgotten. One of them admits to themselves that something has happened.
Beneath the surface
They see each other as they are: a vulnerability is shown and received. The outer obstacle starts to shrink.
Maybe after all
They let themselves hope. The first real closeness, with a clear yes from both.
The midpoint
The kiss, the night or the confession. It seems to hold, but the inner wound is still untouched.

parts.title: The retreat
chapters: The doubt
The old wound makes itself felt, often through something outside: an ex, an offer, a glimpse of a secret.
The wall
One pulls back to stay safe, and the other feels it. The lie about love takes over.
The break-up
It ends, about three quarters of the way in, for a reason rooted in both their wounds. The reader should understand both and still want to shake them.

parts.title: Fighting for love
chapters: The dark night
Life without the other, and what it costs. The side characters say what the leads do not want to hear.
The realisation
Each sees their lie and understands what has to change, inside and not just on the surface.
The grand gesture
Someone risks everything, in a way that heals exactly the wound the book showed at the start. Often both need to act, and whoever did the hurting truly apologises.
Happy ending
Love as it looks when it holds, shown in a scene. Ideally a final image that echoes the first chapter.

name: Feel-good and romantic comedy
hint: A new start, a meeting that grates, warmth, a setback and a warm ending. The lead's new life carries as much as the love story.

parts.title: The new start
chapters: A life in flux
Something ends: a job, a relationship, a city. Show the humour and the voice from the first line.
The place
A town, a shop or a house to land in. Make it both charming and difficult, so there is something to win.
The meeting
Two who should not fit together at all collide, ideally in a funny way. The reader sees the couple before they do.

parts.title: The warmth
chapters: The community
The people around them step forward, each with a quirk. The lead starts, reluctantly, to belong.
The project
A shared goal, saving the café or putting on the festival, forces the couple to work together.
Closer
It grates less and less. An honest talk, a shared laugh, a first kiss.
The good moment
Everything seems possible: the place thrives and love holds. The warmest chapter in the book.

parts.title: The setback
chapters: The past comes back
An ex, an offer from back home or a secret. The lead's old life pulls at them.
The threat
The place is at stake: it may be sold, closed or torn down. Love and the place are threatened by the same thing.
Apart
It looks like it is over, between them and for the place. The lead packs a bag.

parts.title: Home
chapters: The community rallies
The people around step up, and someone dares to say what needs saying.
The choice
The lead chooses the place and love, with a gesture that shows they have changed. The love interest shows they have changed too.
The warm ending
Life as it turned out, better than the plan. A celebration, a new season and hope for what comes next.
